subject: Kickoff: Cardinal Analytics workspace access & API seeding

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@cardinalanalytics.com>, Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@cardinalanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Cardinal Analytics workspace access & API seeding

Hi Laura / Carlos —

Great to meet you both on Thursday. Per our conversation, here’s the proposed path for the initial tenant setup so your engineering and analytics teams can start safe experiments with the Redwood API this week:

- Create workspace + one admin account for Cardinal (we’ll seed service keys).
- Create two project namespaces: analytics-poc and embeddings-sandbox.
- Seed one long-lived service API key scoped to project analytics-poc and one ephemeral key for the frontend tests.
- Provision RBAC: Admin (Laura), Platform (Carlos), Developer tester role (team).
- Share invite cadence for 10 users and a short rotation plan for keys.

I attached a short onboarding checklist and a CSV template we use to seed API key records. Can you confirm: preferred admin email to attach the workspace, which teams need dev access this week (names + emails), and whether you need an on-prem integration or VPC routing?

Next steps I’ll take after your reply:
1) Kick off provisioning sprint and assign tasks to Ben for key seeding and Jonas for role mapping.
2) Share a brief mutual action plan (MAP) with dates.
3) Drop the initial keys in a secure envelope (DocuSign link / encrypted message) and create the invites.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127
Redwood Inference
